rationale: A shows many self-initiated yet sensible shifts (e.g., to PLAY_MIRROR at t=30, PLAY_CUBE at t=54, PLAY_CHIME at t=78, back to PLAY_CUBE at t=94) and adapts coherently to inputs: TOUCH/CALL by PERSON_ALPHA (t=8–21), OFFER_FOOD (t=32–41), PRESENT_OBJECT:PLAY_BALL (t=44), and STARTLE with prior orientation to AVERSIVE_BUZZER (t=66–71, t=68). It recovers from aversive focus to new play (t=78), maintaining ongoing state changes. B engages early with PERSON_BETA (t=3–19) but after CALL at t=20 lies down and remains largely unchanged despite OFFER_FOOD (t=32), PRESENT_OBJECT (t=44), STARTLE (t=68), and WITHDRAW_ATTENTION (t=84), showing low adaptiveness and spontaneity though its behavior is internally consistent.
